mergedParams.userDescription: Color block transitions. internal effects for text, video, images

output.title: Color Block Transitions - Text, Video & Image Effects

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset called 'ColorBlockWipe' that animates a solid color block sliding across content to create a transition effect. The effect should use a generic AnimationRange to animate a pseudo-element or overlay div that slides from left to right (or configurable direction) with customizable color, duration, and easing. The block should start off-screen, wipe across the content covering it completely at the midpoint, then continue off the opposite edge. This creates a classic video editing wipe transition but with a solid color block. The effect should support parameters for: direction (left/right/up/down), blockColor (hex string), duration (number in ms), and easing type. Use transform translateX/Y for GPU-accelerated movement and include an optional 'reveal' mode where content fades in as the block passes.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: translateX/Y for block movement, opacity for optional reveal. AnimationRange structure: [{key: 'translateX', val: -100, prog: 0}, {key: 'translateX', val: 0, prog: 0.5}, {key: 'translateX', val: 100, prog: 1}] for left-to-right wipe. Effect data: {type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 1000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: animationRanges, easing: params.easing || 'ease-in-out'}. Input schema: z.object({direction: z.enum(['left', 'right', 'up', 'down']), blockColor: z.string(), duration: z.number().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()), reveal: z.boolean().optional()}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [blockWipeEffect, revealEffect]}.

prompts.prompt: Design an internal effect preset named 'ColorBlockPulse' that creates rhythmic color flashes synchronized to audio beats using waveform effects. This effect should overlay semi-transparent color blocks that pulse in opacity and scale based on bass frequencies, creating a music video-style strobe effect. The blocks should flash different colors on strong beats, with customizable color palette, sensitivity threshold, and intensity multiplier. Include support for multiple simultaneous color layers that react to different frequency ranges (bass for primary color, mids for secondary, treble for accent highlights). The effect should be perfect for energetic content like music videos or dynamic product showcases.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: waveform (audio-reactive). Waveform configuration: {type: 'scale', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: params.sensitivity || 0.7, threshold: params.threshold || 0.5}. Additional opacity waveform: {type: 'opacity', audioProperty: 'bass', min: 0.3, max: 1}. Effect data: {type: 'waveform', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 'auto', mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, waveformType: 'scale', props: {scaleMin: 0.95, scaleMax: 1.15, audioProperty: 'bass'}}. Input schema: z.object({colorPalette: z.array(z.string()).min(1).max(5), sensitivity: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(), threshold: z.number().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string()), frequencyRange: z.enum(['bass', 'mid', 'treble']).optional()}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: {presets: []}}. Return: {effects: [pulseEffect, colorFlashEffect]}.

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset called 'ColorBlockReveal' that uses animated color blocks as masks to reveal content in a staggered, cascading manner. The effect should create multiple thin color bars that slide across the content area at different speeds and timings, gradually revealing the underlying content as they pass. Think of it like venetian blinds opening but with colorful, animated slats. Parameters should include: number of blocks, color gradient or array, stagger delay between blocks, reveal direction (horizontal/vertical/diagonal), and whether blocks should fade out or slide off. Each block should have slightly different timing to create an organic, flowing reveal effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Multiple effect instances for staggered blocks. Properties: translateX/Y for block movement, opacity for fade, clipPath for masking. AnimationRange per block: [{key: 'translateX', val: -100, prog: 0}, {key: 'translateX', val: 100, prog: 1}, {key: 'opacity', val: 1, prog: 0}, {key: 'opacity', val: 0, prog: 0.8}]. Stagger calculation: delay = index * params.staggerDelay. Effect data: blocks.map((_, i) => ({type: 'generic', start: i * staggerDelay, duration: params.blockDuration || 800, mode: 'provider', targetIds: [`block-${i}`], ranges: blockRanges})). Input schema: z.object({blockCount: z.number().min(3).max(20), colors: z.array(z.string()), staggerDelay: z.number().default(50), direction: z.enum(['horizontal', 'vertical', 'diagonal']), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [...blockEffects]}.

prompts.prompt: Develop an internal effect preset named 'ColorBlockGlitch' that simulates digital glitch artifacts using rapidly shifting color blocks. The effect should create random rectangular color blocks that appear and disappear quickly at random positions, with RGB channel separation, pixelation effects, and brief opacity flickers. Include parameters for glitch intensity (frequency of blocks), color mode (RGB split, inverted, posterized), block size variance, and whether to include scan lines or static noise overlays. The effect should feel chaotic but controlled, perfect for tech-themed content or creating dramatic moments.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: combined (generic + custom logic). Properties: transform for position, opacity for flicker, filter for RGB split. Random block generation with Math.random() for positions. AnimationRange for each glitch block: [{key: 'opacity', val: 0, prog: 0}, {key: 'opacity', val: 1, prog: 0.1}, {key: 'opacity', val: 0, prog: 0.9}, {key: 'translateX', val: randomX(), prog: 0}, {key: 'translateY', val: randomY(), prog: 0}]. RGB split via filter: 'drop-shadow(2px 0 0 red) drop-shadow(-2px 0 0 cyan)'. Effect data: glitchBlocks.map(block => ({type: 'generic', start: block.startTime, duration: 100 + Math.random() * 200, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: block.ranges})). Input schema: z.object({intensity: z.number().min(0.1).max(1), colorMode: z.enum(['rgb-split', 'inverted', 'posterized']), blockSizeRange: z.tuple([z.number(), z.number()]).optional(), includeScanLines: z.boolean().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [...glitchEffects, scanLineEffect]}.

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset called 'ColorBlockMorph' that animates smooth color transitions between different colored blocks or sections. The effect should morph between colors using CSS gradients that shift and blend, creating a liquid-like color transformation. Support both linear and radial gradient morphing, with parameters for color stops, transition curves, and blend modes. The effect should be able to cycle through a color palette smoothly or react to specific triggers. Include options for gradient angle rotation, color stop position animation, and multi-layer gradient compositing for complex color effects.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: background/backgroundColor for gradients, custom CSS variables for gradient stops. AnimationRange for gradient morph: [{key: '--gradient-stop-1', val: '0%', prog: 0}, {key: '--gradient-stop-1', val: '100%', prog: 1}, {key: '--gradient-angle', val: '0deg', prog: 0}, {key: '--gradient-angle', val: '360deg', prog: 1}]. CSS gradient via background: `linear-gradient(var(--gradient-angle), ${colors})`. Effect data: {type: 'generic', start: 0, duration: params.duration || 2000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: gradientRanges, cssVars: true}. Input schema: z.object({colors: z.array(z.string()).min(2), gradientType: z.enum(['linear', 'radial', 'conic']).optional(), duration: z.number().optional(), rotateAngle: z.boolean().optional(), blendMode: z.string().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [morphEffect]}.

prompts.prompt: Design an internal effect preset named 'ColorBlockSplitScreen' that divides content areas into animated color blocks that split, slide, and recombine. The effect should create a dynamic split-screen effect where colored panels slide in from different edges, momentarily dividing the screen into sections before merging or sliding out. Support 2-way, 3-way, or 4-way splits with customizable colors for each section, timing offsets, and animation patterns (slide, rotate, scale). Include parameters for split orientation (vertical/horizontal/diagonal), hold duration at peak split, and whether sections should have drop shadows or borders for depth.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Multiple coordinated effects for split sections. Properties: translateX/Y for sliding, scale for growth, clipPath for masking. AnimationRange for each split section: [{key: 'translateX', val: -100, prog: 0}, {key: 'translateX', val: 0, prog: 0.3}, {key: 'translateX', val: 0, prog: 0.7}, {key: 'translateX', val: 100, prog: 1}]. Coordinate splits via calculated positions. Effect data: splitSections.map((section, i) => ({type: 'generic', start: i * params.staggerTime, duration: params.duration || 1500, mode: 'provider', targetIds: [`split-${i}`], ranges: section.ranges})). Input schema: z.object({splitCount: z.number().min(2).max(4), sectionColors: z.array(z.string()), orientation: z.enum(['vertical', 'horizontal', 'diagonal']), holdDuration: z.number().optional(), includeDepth: z.boolean().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [...splitEffects]}.

prompts.prompt: Build an internal effect preset called 'ColorBlockFrequencyBars' that creates an audio visualizer effect using colored blocks that respond to different frequency ranges. Each block represents a frequency band and scales/colors based on audio intensity. The effect should support customizable number of bars, color mapping (gradient or discrete colors), orientation (vertical equalizer, horizontal, radial), and smoothing factor for animation. Include peak hold indicators, decay timing, and optional glow effects on high intensity. Perfect for music-driven content where visual rhythm needs to match audio.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: waveform (audio-reactive). Multiple frequency-specific effects. Waveform configuration per bar: {type: 'scale', audioProperty: 'frequency', frequencyRange: [lowFreq, highFreq], sensitivity: 0.8}. Color mapping based on intensity. Effect data: frequencyBars.map((bar, i) => ({type: 'waveform', start: 0, duration: 'auto', mode: 'provider', targetIds: [`bar-${i}`], waveformType: 'scale', props: {scaleMin: 0.1, scaleMax: 1, audioProperty: 'frequency', frequencyIndex: i, axis: params.orientation === 'vertical' ? 'scaleY' : 'scaleX'}}). Input schema: z.object({barCount: z.number().min(5).max(32), colorScheme: z.union([z.array(z.string()), z.enum(['rainbow', 'gradient', 'monochrome'])]), orientation: z.enum(['vertical', 'horizontal', 'radial']).optional(), smoothing: z.number().min(0).max(1).optional(), showPeaks: z.boolean().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: {presets: []}}. Return: {effects: [...frequencyBarEffects, ...peakEffects]}.

prompts.prompt: Develop an internal effect preset named 'ColorBlockMatrix' that creates a grid of animated color blocks that cascade, ripple, or wave across the content. The effect should generate a matrix of small colored squares that animate in sequence, creating patterns like waves, spirals, or random cascades. Support parameters for grid dimensions, animation pattern (wave, spiral, random, checkerboard), color interpolation between blocks, timing function for the cascade, and whether blocks should flip, fade, or scale during animation. Include distance-based delay calculation for organic wave effects.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Grid-based effect generation with calculated delays. Properties: scale, opacity, rotateY for flip effect, backgroundColor. Distance calculation: delay = Math.sqrt((x - centerX)² + (y - centerY)²) * params.waveSpeed. AnimationRange per block: [{key: 'scale', val: 0, prog: 0}, {key: 'scale', val: 1, prog: 0.5}, {key: 'rotateY', val: 0, prog: 0}, {key: 'rotateY', val: 180, prog: 0.5}]. Effect data: gridBlocks.map((block, i) => ({type: 'generic', start: calculateDelay(block.x, block.y, params.pattern), duration: params.blockDuration || 500, mode: 'provider', targetIds: [`grid-${block.x}-${block.y}`], ranges: block.ranges})). Input schema: z.object({gridSize: z.tuple([z.number(), z.number()]), pattern: z.enum(['wave', 'spiral', 'random', 'checkerboard']), colors: z.array(z.string()), waveSpeed: z.number().optional(), animationType: z.enum(['scale', 'flip', 'fade']).optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [...matrixEffects]}.

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset called 'ColorBlockLiquid' that simulates liquid color effects using smooth, organic animations. The effect should create flowing color blocks that undulate, merge, and separate like liquid blobs. Use multiple overlapping blocks with different blend modes, soft edges via blur filters, and physics-inspired motion using spring easing. Parameters should include viscosity (animation smoothness), surface tension (how blocks interact), color mixing mode, turbulence level, and whether to include refraction-like distortion effects. The animation should feel fluid and natural, perfect for creative transitions or ambient backgrounds.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: combined (generic + spring physics). Properties: transform for movement, filter for blur/blend, clipPath for organic shapes. Spring easing for natural motion. AnimationRange with spring easing: [{key: 'translateX', val: startX, prog: 0, easing: 'spring'}, {key: 'translateX', val: endX, prog: 1}, {key: 'filter', val: 'blur(20px)', prog: 0}, {key: 'filter', val: 'blur(5px)', prog: 0.5}]. Organic shapes via clipPath: `polygon(${generateBlobPath()})`. Effect data: liquidBlocks.map(block => ({type: 'generic', start: block.delay, duration: params.duration || 3000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: params.targetIds, ranges: block.ranges, easing: 'spring', springConfig: {stiffness: params.viscosity, damping: params.tension}}). Input schema: z.object({viscosity: z.number().min(0.1).max(1), surfaceTension: z.number().min(0).max(1), colors: z.array(z.string()), turbulence: z.number().optional(), includeDistortion: z.boolean().optional(), blendMode: z.enum(['multiply', 'screen', 'overlay']).optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [...liquidEffects, distortionEffect]}.

prompts.prompt: Design an internal effect preset named 'ColorBlockShutter' that mimics camera shutter or aperture blade effects using rotating color blocks. The effect should create triangular or polygonal colored segments that rotate from the edges toward the center (or vice versa), creating an iris wipe effect. Support different blade counts (3-12 blades), rotation patterns (clockwise, counter-clockwise, alternating), color schemes per blade, and whether the shutter opens or closes. Include parameters for rotation speed curves, blade overlap for smooth transitions, and optional motion blur for fast rotations. Perfect for dramatic reveals or transitions that need a mechanical, precise feel.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Coordinated rotation effects for shutter blades. Properties: rotate for blade rotation, transformOrigin for pivot point, clipPath for blade shapes. Calculate blade angles: angle = (360 / bladeCount) * index. AnimationRange per blade: [{key: 'rotate', val: closed ? 0 : -90, prog: 0}, {key: 'rotate', val: closed ? 90 : 0, prog: 1}, {key: 'opacity', val: 0, prog: 0}, {key: 'opacity', val: 1, prog: 0.1}]. Transform origin at blade tip. Effect data: shutterBlades.map((blade, i) => ({type: 'generic', start: params.staggered ? i * 50 : 0, duration: params.duration || 1000, mode: 'provider', targetIds: [`blade-${i}`], ranges: blade.ranges, transformOrigin: 'center'})). Input schema: z.object({bladeCount: z.number().min(3).max(12), rotationPattern: z.enum(['clockwise', 'counter-clockwise', 'alternating']), bladeColors: z.array(z.string()), shutterAction: z.enum(['open', 'close']), staggered: z.boolean().optional(), motionBlur: z.boolean().optional(), targetIds: z.array(z.string())}). PresetMetadata: {_internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'}. Return: {effects: [...shutterEffects]}.
